steps.label: People reach it two ways: a browser through Caddy, and Signal to the assistant
Caddy is the only public door, and one Nextcloud login opens every private name
The assistant keeps the agenda: it books meetings on the calendars and makes their Talk call links
Calls run through the media box, and a recorded call becomes minutes in the repository
Prometheus watches the server and hands every alert to the assistant
Every change starts on the laptop as a push; the server tests it, pulls the vault and ships
